mediauploader-desc: Soo geliye dabacsan, faylal badan, tallaabo-tallaabo ah.
tag-uploadwizard-description: Soo gelinno lagu sameeyay Soo geliye Warbaahinta
right-mass-upload: Hal mar ku soo geli faylal badan adigoo adeegsanaya Soo geliye Warbaahinta
action-mass-upload: Dufcadda ku soo geli faylal badan hal mar adigoo adeegsanaya Soo geliye Warbaahinta
mediauploader-api-error-parsererror: Server-ku wuxuu ka jawaabay dukumenti JSON ah oo aan sax ahayn. Tani waxay dhibaato ka noqon kartaa API-ga, ama waxaa laga yaabaa inaad isticmaalayso server wakiil ah oo kaa hor istaagaya inaad faylal soo geliso.
mediauploader-api-error-noimageinfo: Soo gelintu way guulaysatay, laakiin server-ku nama siin wax macluumaad ah oo ku saabsan faylka.
mediauploader-unavailable: Barowsarkaaga lama jaanqaadi karo Soo geliye Warbaahinta ama JavaScript-ka ayaa dansan, sidaas darteed waxaan ku tusaynaa foom soo gelin fudud.
mediauploader-extension-disabled: Boggan waa la naafoobay sababo la xiriira dhibaatooyin farsamo oo ku meel gaar ah. Inta ka horreysa isku day foomka caadiga ah ee soo gelinta.
mediauploader-campaign-name-duplicate: Olol leh magacan ayaa hore u jiray.
mediauploader-campaign-unknown-error: Cilad aan la aqoon ayaa dhacday.
mediauploader-api-warning-exists: Waxaa jira [$1 fayl kale] oo horey wiki-ga ugu jira oo leh isla magaca faylka
mediauploader-add-file-0-free: Dooro faylasha warbaahinta ee la wadaagayo
mediauploader-multi-file-select2: Dooro faylasha aad jeclaan lahayd inaad soo geliso. Hay furaha Shift oo guji si aad hal mar u doorato faylal badan. Waxaad dooran kartaa ilaa $1 {{PLURAL:$1|fayl|faylal}} si aad u soo geliso.
mediauploader-override-upload: Soo geli faylkan si kastaba ha ahaatee.
mediauploader-remove-upload: Ka saar faylkan liiska faylasha la soo gelinayo
mediauploader-file-all-ok: Dhammaan soo gelinnadu si guul leh ayay u dhaceen!
mediauploader-file-some-failed: Qaar ka mid ah soo gelinnadu way fashilmeen.
mediauploader-file-all-failed: Midna ka mid ah faylasha lama soo gelin si guul leh.
mediauploader-upload-count: $1 ka mid ah $2 {{PLURAL:$2|fayl|faylal}} ayaa la soo geliyay
mediauploader-deeds-macro-prompt: Boggan wuxuu kaa doonayaa {{GENDER:$2|inaad}} bixiso macluumaadka xuquuqda daabacaadda ee {{PLURAL:$1|shaqadan|shaqooyinkan}}, si loo hubiyo in qof walba uu si sharci ah dib ugu isticmaali karo {{PLURAL:$1|iyadoo|iyaga}}.
mediauploader-source-ownwork-assert: Aniga, $2, {{GENDER:$4|qofka haysta xuquuqda daabacaadda}}, waxaan si aan laga noqon karin qof kasta u siinayaa xaqa uu u leeyahay inuu isticmaalo {{PLURAL:$1|shaqadan|shaqooyinkan}} iyadoo la raacayo shatiga soo socda:
mediauploader-source-thirdparty-custom-m: Haddii dhammaan faylashu leeyihiin isla isha, qoraaga, iyo xaaladda xuquuqda daabacaadda, waxaad macluumaadkaas hal mar oo keliya u gelin kartaa dhammaantood.
mediauploader-source-thirdparty-cases: Hadda noo sheeg sababta aad u hubto inaad xaq u leedahay inaad daabacdo {{PLURAL:$1|shaqadan|shaqooyinkan}}:
mediauploader-source-custom: Bixi macluumaadka xuquuqda daabacaadda ee fayl kasta si gaar ah bogga xiga.
mediauploader-more-options: Ku dar goobta iyo macluumaad dheeraad ah…
mediauploader-copy-metadata: Nuqul macluumaadka dhammaan soo gelinnada xiga…
mediauploader-multilang-add: {{PLURAL:$1|0=Ku dar qoraal|Ku dar qoraal luuqad kale}}
mediauploader-thanks-intro: Waad ku mahadsan tahay soo gelinta!
mediauploader-thanks-explain: Hadda waxaad {{PLURAL:$1|faylkan|faylashan}} ku isticmaali kartaa wiki-ga, ama {{PLURAL:$1|waxaad ugu xiriirin|waxaad ugu}} xiriirin kartaa shabakadda.
mediauploader-thanks-wikitext: Si aad faylka ugu isticmaasho wiki, qoraalkan ku koobbi bog:
mediauploader-thanks-url: Si aad ugu xirto HTML, koobbi URL-kan:
mediauploader-upload-error-bad-filename-: Wiki-kan ma aqbalo magacyada faylasha ku dhammaada kordhinta ".$1".
Wiki-kan wuxuu u baahan yahay in faylashu lahaadaan kordhin — sida ".JPG" oo ku taal dhammaadka magaca faylka.
mediauploader-upload-error-duplicate-fil: Waxaad horey u soo gelinaysaa faylka "$1".
mediauploader-upload-error-duplicate: Faylkan hore ayaa loogu soo geliyay wiki-kan.
mediauploader-upload-error-duplicate-arc: Faylkan hore ayaa loogu soo geliyay wiki-kan, laakiin markii dambe waa la tirtiray.
mediauploader-fileexists-replace-on-page: Fayl magacan wata ayaa hore u jira. Haddii aad rabto inaad beddesho, tag bogga [$2 $1] oo halkaas ku beddel.
mediauploader-fileexists-replace-no-link: Fadlan dooro cinwaan kale, sababtoo ah cinwaankan waxaa horey u isticmaalaya fayl kale.
mediauploader-blacklisted-details: Fadlan dooro cinwaan kale oo sharraxaad leh ([$2 macluumaad dheeraad ah]).
mediauploader-home: Ugu dub bogga hore ee wiki-ga
mediauploader-tooltip-skiptutorial: Waxaad dib u hawlgelin kartaa casharkan adigoo ka galaya [$1 dookhyada isticmaalaha], qaybta $2 → $3.
mediauploader-tooltip-author: Magaca qofka sawirka qaaday, ama sawirka rinjiyeeyay, sawirka gacanta ku sawiray, iwm.
mediauploader-tooltip-source: Meesha uu faylkan dhijitaalka ahi ka yimid — waxay noqon kartaa URL, ama buug ama daabacaad.
mediauploader-tooltip-sign:
Waxaad isticmaali kartaa magaca isticmaalaha wiki-gaaga ama magacaaga dhabta ah.
Labada xaaladoodba, tani waxay ku xirnaan doontaa bogga isticmaalaha ee wiki-gaaga.
mediauploader-tooltip-title: Abuur cinwaan sharraxaad leh oo gaar ah adigoo adeegsanaya luuqad cad oo leh firaaqooyin. Ka tag kordhinta faylka, haddii ay jirto.
mediauploader-tooltip-description: Bixi dhammaan macluumaadka ka caawin doona dadka kale inay fahmaan waxa faylkani matalayo.
mediauploader-tooltip-date: Dooro taariikhda shaqadan la sameeyay ama markii ugu horreysay la daabacay.
mediauploader-tooltip-categories: Ku dar faylkaaga [{{fullurl:Special:Categories}} qaybaha] si ay u fududaato in la helo.
mediauploader-tooltip-other: Macluumaad kasta oo kale oo aad rabto inaad ku darto shaqadan.
mediauploader-tooltip-location: Samee koodka juqraafiyeed ee faylkaaga si aad u aqoonsato meesha warbaahinta lagu duubay (mar walba faa'iido ma leh in goob lagu geliyo nooc kasta oo warbaahin ah).
mediauploader-file-need-file: Fadlan marka hore soo geli fayl.
mediauploader-deeds-need-deed: Fadlan sharax meesha aad ka heshay faylkan iyo sida boggani u isticmaali karo, adigoo dooranaya mid ka mid ah xulashooyinka.
mediauploader-license-show-recommended: Isticmaal shaatiga uu boggu ku taliyay
mediauploader-error-signature-blank: Waa inaad ku saxiixdaa magaca isticmaalahaaga ama magacaaga dhabta ah goobta ku habboon.
mediauploader-error-latitude: Loolku waa inuu noqdaa tiro u dhexeysa -90 iyo 90.
mediauploader-error-longitude: Dhererku waa inuu noqdaa tiro u dhexeysa -180 iyo 180.
mediauploader-error-heading: Jihadu waa inay noqotaa tiro u dhexeysa 0 iyo 360.
mediauploader-error-signature-too-long:
Saxiixaagu aad buu u dheer yahay.
Ka dhig mid ka gaaban $1 {{PLURAL:$1|xaraf|xarafo}}.
mediauploader-error-signature-too-short:
Saxiixaagu aad buu u gaaban yahay.

Fadlan hubi in gelintani ay ugu badnaan tahay $1 {{PLURAL:$1|xaraf|xarfo}}.
mediauploader-error-too-short:
Gelintani aad bay u gaaban tahay.

Cinwaankani aad buu u dheer yahay.
Fadlan hubi in cinwaankani uu ugu badnaan yahay $1 {{PLURAL:$1|bayt|baytyada}}.
mediauploader-error-title-too-short:
Cinwaankani aad buu u gaaban yahay.
Fadlan hubi in cinwaankani uu ugu yaraan yahay $1 {{PLURAL:$1|bayt|baytyada}}.
mediauploader-error-bad-multilang: Dhibaatooyin ayaa ka jira qaar ka mid ah qiimayaasha.
mediauploader-error-title-blacklisted: Cinwaankani wuxuu ka kooban yahay qoraal aan la rabin. Fadlan dib u habee.
mediauploader-error-title-senselessimage: Fadlan ka dhig cinwaankan mid macno badan leh.
mediauploader-error-title-thumbnail: Tani waxay u egtahay cinwaan sawir yar yar ah. Fadlan ha dib ugu soo gelin sawir yar wiki-ga isla kan. Haddii kale, fadlan sax magaca faylka si uu u noqdo mid macno badan leh, oo uusan lahayn horgalaha sawir yar yar.
mediauploader-error-title-extension: Uma baahnid inaad ku darto kordhinta faylka. Kaliya samee cinwaan uu qofku si fudud u akhrisan karo, annaguna inta kale waan qabanaynaa.
mediauploader-error-title-protected: Cinwaankani wuxuu u dhigmaa bog la ilaaliyay oo ku yaal wiki-kan. Fadlan dooro cinwaan kale.
mediauploader-error-title-duplicate: Cinwaankan waxaa loo cayimay wax ka badan hal fayl oo aad soo gelinayso. Calaamadaha hoosta ka xarriiqan waxaa loo tixgeliyaa firaaqooyin, kordhinta faylkana si otomaatig ah ayaa loogu daraa.
mediauploader-error-license-wikitext-mis: Waxaad dooratay xulasho kaa doonaysa inaad geliso wikitext.
mediauploader-error-license-wikitext-too: Wikitext-ka halkan ku jira aad buu u gaaban yahay si uu u noqdo shaatiga
Wikitext-ka aad gelisay aad buu u dheer yahay.
mediauploader-warning-value-missing: Waxaa lagu talinayaa inaad buuxiso goobta '$1'.
mediauploader-warning-postdate: Taariikhda aad dooratay waxay ku jirtaa mustaqbalka.
mediauploader-details-error-count: Waxaa jira {{PLURAL:$1|hal qalad|$1 qalad}} oo ku jira {{PLURAL:$2|foomka|foomamka}} kore. Sax {{PLURAL:$1|qaladka|qaladaadka}}, oo isku day inaad mar kale gudbiso.
mediauploader-details-warning-count: Waxaa jira {{PLURAL:$1|hal digniin|$1 digniin}} oo ku jirta {{PLURAL:$2|foomka|foomamka}} kore. Waxaan kugula talinaynaa inaad saxdo {{PLURAL:$1|digniinta|digniinaha}} ka hor intaadan sii wadin.
mediauploader-too-many-files-text: Waxaad hal mar soo gelin kartaa oo keliya $1 {{PLURAL:$1|fayl|faylal}} laakiin waxaad isku dayday inaad soo geliso $2 {{PLURAL:$2|fayl|faylal}} wadar ahaan. Fadlan mar kale isku day adigoo isticmaalaya faylal ka yar!
mediauploader-file-too-large-text: Waxaad soo gelin kartaa oo keliya faylal cabbirkoodu yahay ilaa $1. Waxaad isku dayday inaad soo geliso fayl cabbirkiisu yahay $2.
mediauploader-file-too-large: Faylku aad buu u weyn yahay.
mediauploader-dialog-warning: Waxaan kugula talinaynaa inaad si sax ah u buuxiso dhammaan goobaha. Ma doonaysaa inaad sii waddo adigoon saxin digniinahan?

mediauploader-campaign-no-uploads-yet: Weli wax soo gelin ah ma jirto!

mediauploader-license-none-head: Waxaan ka helay internetka — ma hubo

mediauploader-license-generic: Waxaan dib u eegay [[{{int:disclaimerpage}}|afeefka wiki-gan]] waxaana, inta aan ogahay, {{PLURAL:$1|shaqadani|shaqooyinkani}} aysan hoos iman heerar ilaalinta xogta oo ka sarreeya kuwa wiki-gan.
mediauploader-license-confirm-remove: Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad ka saarto {{PLURAL:$1|soo gelintan|soo gelintaan}}?
mediauploader-categories-missing: Mid ka mid ah qaybaha ayaa ka maqan bogga sharaxaadda. Ma hubtaa inaad magaca si sax ah u qortay?
mediauploader-thumbnail-failed: Soo gelintu way guulaysatay, laakiin server-ku ma heli karin sawirka yar ee hordhaca ah.
mediauploader-error-title-invalid: Cinwaankani ma saxna. Hubi inaad ka saarto jilayaasha sida qawsyada afar geeska ah, laba dhibcood, jiirarka, calaamadaha isbarbardhigga, tuubooyinka iyo qawsyada laabma.

mediauploader-global-config-anchor:
'''Boggan wuxuu u adeegaa sidii barroosin loogu talagalay qaabaynta guud ee Soo geliyaha Warbaahinta.'''

Waxaa loo baahan yahay si qaabaynta si sax ah loo cusboonaysiiyo marka mid ka mid ah template-yada lagu isticmaalo la beddelo. Fadlan ha guurin ama ha tirtirin boggan.
mediauploader-default-tutorial-text: === Kani waa farriinta casharka ee caadiga ah === Tallaabada casharku waa meel wanaagsan oo lagu sharxo xeerarka ku saabsan soo gelinta faylasha isticmaalayaasha wiki-gaaga. * Waxaad gebi ahaanba damin kartaa casharka adigoo dejinaya $wgMediaUploader['tutorial']['enabled'] = false;. Tani waxay u badan tahay inay tahay doorashada ugu wanaagsan wiki-yada gudaha. * Ama waxaad beddeli kartaa wikitext-ka casharka adigoo adeegsanaya dejintan: $wgMediaUploader['tutorial']['wikitext'] = 'some wikitext';. Fadlan tixraac [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:MediaUploader/Configuration dukumentiga] si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah.
